questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer tot, i
Set tot = 0, i = 1
while(i <= 5)
    Set tot = tot + (i * 2)
    Set i = i + 2
End while
Print tot
questions.explanation: Loop runs for i values where i <= 5 with step 2. Summing i * 2 at each iteration results in tot = 18.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer val, x
Set val = 0, x = 18
while(x > 0)
    Set val = val + x
    if(val > 25)
        Jump out of loop
    End if
    Set x = x - 3
End while
Print val
questions.explanation: Starting with x = 18, each iteration adds x to val and decrements x by 3. The loop breaks when val > 25. Final val = 33.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer count, i, j
Set count = 0
for(i = 1 to 4)
    for(j = 1 to 2)
        Set count = count + (i + j)
    End for
End for
Print count
questions.explanation: Outer loop runs from 1 to 4, inner loop runs from 1 to 2. Adding (i + j) in each inner iteration sums to count = 32.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer prod, x
Set prod = 1, x = 1
while(x <= 7)
    Set prod = (prod * x) mod 100
    Set x = x + 2
End while
Print prod
questions.explanation: x starts at 1 and increases by 2 up to 7. Multiplying and taking mod 100 at each step yields prod = 5.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer s, i
Set s = 0
for(i = 1 to 10)
    if(i mod 2 EQUALS 0)
        Set s = s + i
    else
        Set s = s + 1
    End if
End for
Print s
questions.explanation: Iterating from 1 to 10: even values add i, odd values add 1. Final sum s = 35.
